title: Background Jobs & Messaging: Retries, Idempotent Workers & Dead-Letter Queues
concept: Move slow work out of the request without losing it or doing it twice: job states, retries with backoff and jitter, idempotent workers, visibility timeouts, dead-letter queues and redrive, queue lag you can alert on, and the poison message that blocks everything.
description: An advanced course for backend developers who run workers behind their API. Every lesson starts from an incident on the CodeDev learning platform - a code-grading queue that grew to 80,000 jobs behind one malformed submission, certificate emails sent twice after a worker restart, an AI-written retry loop that retried validation errors forever, a job that ran twice because it took longer than its visibility timeout - and fixes it with a pattern you can test: what belongs in a job, job state machines, backoff and jitter, at-least-once delivery and idempotent workers, visibility timeouts, dead-letter queues and redrive, measuring queue lag, the Poison Message & Growing Queue scenario and duplicate side effects. 12 lessons with True/False quizzes on real logs and metrics, and TypeScript challenges graded by hidden tests on an in-memory queue.

learningOutcomes.text: Decide what moves to a background job and model job states that cannot go wrong
Retry only what can succeed, with bounded exponential backoff and jitter
Make workers idempotent so duplicate deliveries never duplicate side effects
Handle poison messages with max attempts, dead-letter queues, redrive and visibility timeouts
Measure queue lag and age and alert before the queue becomes an incident

testedVersions.Queues: BullMQ / SQS / RabbitMQ concepts in lesson examples (check current docs)

knownIssues: No message broker in the code runner: challenges use an in-memory queue with a fake clock that follows the delivery rules taught

lessons.title: What belongs in a background job, and what doesn't
Job states that can't go wrong: queued, running, succeeded, failed
Visibility timeouts: when a slow job runs twice
Spot the AI mistake: retrying errors that can never succeed
Poison message & a growing queue: one bad job blocks 80,000
Fix it: certificate emails sent twice
Scaling workers: concurrency, rate limits & fairness
